# Kare-Kya Context

Read and follow the [shared project rules](../AGENTS.md).
Use the [folder map](../README.md), [workshop](../docs/workshop.md), and
[lifecycle guide](../docs/lifecycle.md) to locate the relevant work.

Load the task-specific skills under `skills/` when their descriptions match.
Use the planner for read-only planning and the reviewer for independent read-only review.
Never confuse editor MCP connections with application runtime tool permissions.

Before MCP implementation, consult the official [Python MCP SDK](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk)
and [PydanticAI MCP client documentation](https://pydantic.dev/docs/ai/mcp/client/).
Check documentation against the installed and locked package versions.
